title: Hauntboard
summary: Ootle message board with public threads and optional AES-256-GCM sealed message bodies. Titles, categories, fees, graph and timing remain public; accepted posts cannot be edited or deleted, and testnet resets can remove history. Invitation links carry a shared key: holders can read past and future messages, share access and impersonate participants; access cannot be revoked and authorship is not authenticated. Wallet recovery does not restore invitation keys. On October 16, 2026, the public reader and privacy explanation loaded with the wallet locked; repository revision 0598b28 documents schema 4 and the sealed-body flow. No encrypted message, wallet, post or payment action was tested. Prior outage and recovery evidence remains in the maintenance history.
cardSummary: Read Ootle discussions with public threads or invitation-encrypted message bodies, while titles and categories remain public.
